## Features

- ✅ 754 scripts fully organized
- ✅ 13 functional categories
- ✅ 100% documentation coverage
- ✅ Meaningful folder naming
- ✅ Complete metadata files
- ✅ Easy navigation with README links

## Installation

1. Choose a category
2. Select a script
3. Read the script's README
4. Copy files to Sphere scripts directory
5. Update sphere.ini if needed
6. Restart your server

## Compatibility

- Sphere 0.55i (most scripts)
- Sphere 0.56d (modern versions)
- Sphere 0.54 (legacy)
- Check individual READMEs for specifics
